title: [Kyncera's Cabin]
description: Hook-gathered lengths of velvet and brocade are draped across the wood-planked walls, the rich, ocean-colored tones partially obscured by the various flags displayed in states of disarray.  A cushion-covered bed spans the back of the cabin, curtained off in silver and gilt-beaded silks, the arabesques spilling down across the raised platform.  Nestled in the corner is a worn leather chair encircled by a pair of round tables, the surface covered by several bottles and blown-glass instruments.
